text:
sam: customer (Acme Inc) flagged duplicate billing for the same API call. Invoice INV-2418 shows two line items for the same timestamp. request-id from customer: req_01F8Z2K4ABCD. Can someone triage? :frowning:

maya: thanks — can you paste the request headers and the raw responses from the client? especially any idempotency-key or x-request-id headers.

sam: here's what they sent (redacted keys):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rw1-large","input":"Summarize..."}'
```
client reported a 504 gateway timeout, then retried the same curl (no Idempotency-Key header). Customer timeline: initial call 2025-11-02T14:12:03Z, retry at 14:12:11Z. They sent the same payload.

sam: They also attached our response logs from their side: first attempt got timeout, second returned 200 and tokens billed twice according to their invoice: token_count ~ 2,340 each.

ryan: ack. Gateway sometimes retries at the LB layer when upstream ack isn't seen — that can replay a request end-to-end when there is no idempotency token. Does the ingress set a unique request fingerprint in the header (x-rw-request) that the billing pipeline can use?

maya: our billing dedupe currently prefers the Idempotency-Key header. If missing, we fall back to request hash + short time-window (30s). If a client retries > 5s later we might count it as a separate usage.

neha: pulled ledger rows for req_01F8Z2K4ABCD: two entries:
```
ledger_id | customer_id | request_hash | tokens | ts
----------------------------------------------
led_9312  | acme        | 0x7f9a3b     | 2340   | 2025-11-02T14:12:03Z
led_9313  | acme        | 0x7f9a3b     | 2340   | 2025-11-02T14:12:11Z
```
so identical request_hash, separate ledger rows. billing pipeline accepted both.

maya: that matches. So root cause looks like: client retried after gateway timeout; no Idempotency-Key; gateway forwarded both attempts; billing dedupe window treated them as separate because they were > 5s apart.

sam: customer is asking for refund for the duplicate charge. They flagged this as urgent — it's a PLG trial account and they might churn.

neha: I can do a manual credit. I'll create a credit note and link to INV-2418, refunding led_9313. I'll also attach an explanation. Creating CN-557 now.

ryan: longer-term fix proposals:
- require Idempotency-Key for generation endpoints (soft-enforce with warning headers first week).
- ingress: set an authoritative x-rw-request-id at the edge and surface it to billing so dedupe uses that instead of just request_hash/time-window.
- gateway: treat a 504 + upstream uncertainty as "unknown" and avoid reissuing if client already timed out, or keep retries within same connection where possible.

maya: engineering follow-up: open an internal bug for billing pipeline dedupe behavior. We should make fallback dedupe window longer (e.g., 120s) for big token charges, and prefer the ingress request id when present. I'll create BI-789.

ryan: I'll also add a small runtime change to the gateway: when we see same request_hash and identical payload within 60s, and if upstream returned success for one, block the replay. That will be a short PR to gateway (estimated 2d).

sam: for the customer: I've told them we will issue a credit (CN-557) and will follow up with engineering changes. They've accepted.

neha: credit created and applied to INV-2418. CN-557 linked -> refunded 2340 tokens worth.

eng-gateway-bot: deployed a temporary guard in canary: ingress will now inject x-rw-request-id when missing and forward to billing. Monitor for false dedupe alerts.

maya: action items summary:
- neha: refund + customer comms (done).
- maya: create BI-789 for billing dedupe change.
- ryan: gateway PR to prefer request-id dedupe + small defense for replay.
- ops: monitor canary spans for dropped responses next 48h.

sam: thanks all. Customer happy for now but wants the platform to avoid these surprises. Please ping me when BI-789 and gateway PRs are linked so I can update them. :thumbsup:

ryan: noted — will link PRs in this thread once opened. :eyes:
